newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Feed Grains Council mulls name change.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Feed Grains Council mulls name change.

text.p: The U.S. Feed Grains Council voted Tuesday to investigate a name change for the group that would reflect members' interests in food products as well as animal feed.

At a meeting of the group's board of directors, the council agreed to develop several possible names to present to members later this year. A final vote on a name change will take place at the council's full membership meeting in February.

The council, which promotes exports of corn, barley and sorghum, operates several international offices. The group was sometimes viewed as an arm of the U.S. government, or representing only animal feed interests, because of its current name, members said.
